intro: A Shimmering Frond is a specimen harvested from a strange, glowing plant growing within the Oracle Glade of Teldrassil. Its unusual luminescence and twisting aura reveal it to be an exotic species entirely alien to the boughs of the World Tree.

p: While wandering the verdant canopies around the Oracle Glade, travelers may come across strange vegetation boasting a pulsing, radiant aura. The fronds plucked from this plant catch the filtered woodland light in unnatural ways, shimmering with vibrant vitality. Denalan, a botanist tending to his planters by Lake Al'Ameth, recognizes the foliage immediately as a species native to the distant Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. How seeds from a marsh so far across the Great Sea managed to take root and flourish upon the newly raised Teldrassil remains an intriguing mystery, prompting Denalan to sprout and study specimens in his own soil.
